_meta.notes: FLAG CONFIRMED (both halves of the chunk-file flag are real). (1) The clerk's RECEIVED IN OFFICE stamp reads APR 0 2 2018 while the Report Verification signature is dated 4-3-18 - the stamp PREDATES the signature by one day. Both recorded verbatim; nothing resolved. (2) The Summary Page's Column B is struck through and rewritten by hand on BOTH money lines, and line 7 of Column A is struck and rewritten as well. Per the clerk-legacy rule the handwritten correction governs the value and the struck figure is kept verbatim here: line 1 Column B struck figure best-read '17,455.2?' (heavily crossed, not confidently legible) rewritten '20,610.2'; line 2 Column B struck figure best-read '9885.98' rewritten '9985.98'; line 7 Column A struck '10.724.23' rewritten '10.624.23'. Nothing was reconciled silently. (3) total_contributions_to_date is recorded as the partial '20,610.2': the cell's final glyph sits ON the table's right-hand vertical rule and a possible trailing digit cannot be separated from the rule even at 1200dpi, so the value is left PARTIAL at low confidence rather than completed (per the superscript-runs-off-the-cell convention). (4) ending_balance is recorded verbatim as '10.624.23' - the filer's thousands separator on this line is a round dot indistinguishable from his decimal point (he uses a clear tailed comma on line 5 '11,435.21' and on line 1 Column B). The arithmetic 11,435.21 - 810.98 = 10,624.23 settles the VALUE as $10,624.23; the verbatim string is kept as printed and the shared whitelisted repair should read it as such. (5) Cover 'Is this report an amendment?' has NEITHER the Yes nor the No box checked - is_amendment is honestly blank, not 'No'. (6) The top-row Office box reads 'SLCo. COUNCIL AT-LARGE C' and the separate Office Sought box reads 'COUNCIL AT-LARGE C'; office_sought takes the Office Sought box. Both agree with index.csv (JIM BRADLEY / County Council / At-Large C, 2018-04-03, April 5). (7) The chunk file records schedule_a as 'not-inspected (the Schedule A page was not among the pages read)'; it EXISTS - p3 is a county-grid Schedule A with two filled rows. (8) Schedule A's Complete Mailing Address column is covered by the county's black bar on both rows: donor_city/donor_state are blank as 'redacted at source', NOT left empty by the filer - different facts. Occupation/Employer survives the bar on both rows and is captured verbatim.
